book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: I sat in Baghdad and lived comfortably.

sentences.ar: بس بعد سنة، صرت أزهق من الراحة.
sentences.en: But after a year, I began to tire of comfort.
I thought about the sea every day.

sentences.ar: اشتريت بضاعة جديدة وركبت سفينة تانية.
sentences.en: I bought new goods and boarded another ship.

sentences.ar: وقفنا عند جزيرة خضرا وفيها مي حلوة.
sentences.en: We stopped at a green island with fresh water.
I ate and drank and slept under a tree.
When I woke, the ship had gone.
They forgot me while I was asleep.
